info.desc: chronic is the debut album by Brazilian artist twikipedia. It was released on December 9, 2022. All tracks were produced, written, and mixed by twikipedia. twikipedia first hinted at the project on June 7, when they posted the first draft of the tracklist to their Instagram story, claiming the project (which was going to be an EP at the time) was around 65% complete. On June 9, twikipedia revealed the first draft of the cover art. Then, on June 21, the official cover art was revealed via their Instagram story.
